reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program (Oklahoma, focus year 2021)
    Question: In an eviction action, can a tenant use landlord noncompliance with a statutory duty as a rebuttal/defense?

    Statutes encoded:
      - 41 OK Stat  41-121 (2021)  [tenant remedies for landlord noncompliance; notice prerequisites; repair-and-deduct; essential services; uninhabitability]
      - 41 OK Stat  41-123 (2021)  [tenant remedy for wrongful removal/exclusion]
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic domain facts (state/year) for this Q&A instance
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

qa_state(oklahoma).
focus_year(2021).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translations (deterministic, with citations)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   41 OK Stat  41-121(E) (2021)
   "All rights of the tenant under this section do not arise until he has given
    written notice to the landlord ... [and] not if the condition ... was caused
    by the deliberate or negligent act or omission of the tenant ..."
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

% statute_41_121_rights_arise_after_notice(+WrittenNoticeGiven, +ConditionCausedByTenantOrHousehold)
statute_41_121_rights_arise_after_notice(true, false) :- !.
statute_41_121_rights_arise_after_notice(_, _) :- fail.

% For convenience: determines whether a tenant can invoke any 41-121 remedy.
% statute_41_121_remedy_prereqs_met(+WrittenNoticeGiven, +ConditionCausedByTenantOrHousehold)
statute_41_121_remedy_prereqs_met(WrittenNoticeGiven, ConditionCausedByTenantOrHousehold) :-
    statute_41_121_rights_arise_after_notice(WrittenNoticeGiven, ConditionCausedByTenantOrHousehold),
    !.

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   41 OK Stat  41-121(A) (2021)
   Material noncompliance by landlord (rental agreement or Section 18) materially
   affecting health or safety -> tenant may terminate after notice + cure period.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

% statute_41_121a_termination_available(+MaterialNoncompliance, +AffectsHealthOrSafety, +WrittenNoticeGiven, +ConditionCausedByTenantOrHousehold)
statute_41_121a_termination_available(true, true, WrittenNoticeGiven, ConditionCausedByTenantOrHousehold) :-
    statute_41_121_remedy_prereqs_met(WrittenNoticeGiven, ConditionCausedByTenantOrHousehold),
    !.
statute_41_121a_termination_available(_, _, _, _) :- fail.

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   41 OK Stat  41-121(B) (2021)
   If breach remediable by repairs, reasonable cost < $100, tenant can notify of
   intent to correct after 14 days; then may deduct actual/reasonable cost (<=100).
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

% statute_41_121b_repair_and_deduct_available(+MaterialNoncompliance, +AffectsHealth, +RepairCost, +WrittenNoticeGiven, +ConditionCausedByTenantOrHousehold)
statute_41_121b_repair_and_deduct_available(true, true, RepairCost, WrittenNoticeGiven, ConditionCausedByTenantOrHousehold) :-
    number(RepairCost),
    RepairCost < 100.0,
    statute_41_121_remedy_prereqs_met(WrittenNoticeGiven, ConditionCausedByTenantOrHousehold),
    !.
statute_41_121b_repair_and_deduct_available(_, _, _, _, _) :- fail.

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   41 OK Stat  41-121(C) (2021)
   Willful/negligent failure to supply essential services -> after written notice,
   tenant may: terminate immediately; procure and deduct; recover damages; procure
   substitute housing and be excused from paying rent for the period of noncompliance.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

% statute_41_121c_essential_service_remedies_available(+EssentialServiceFailure, +WrittenNoticeGiven, +ConditionCausedByTenantOrHousehold)
statute_41_121c_essential_service_remedies_available(true, WrittenNoticeGiven, ConditionCausedByTenantOrHousehold) :-
    statute_41_121_remedy_prereqs_met(WrittenNoticeGiven, ConditionCausedByTenantOrHousehold),
    !.
statute_41_121c_essential_service_remedies_available(_, _, _) :- fail.

% statute_41_121c_rent_excused_if_substitute_housing(+EssentialServiceFailure, +SubstituteHousingProcuredWithNotice, +WrittenNoticeGiven, +ConditionCausedByTenantOrHousehold)
statute_41_121c_rent_excused_if_substitute_housing(true, true, WrittenNoticeGiven, ConditionCausedByTenantOrHousehold) :-
    statute_41_121c_essential_service_remedies_available(true, WrittenNoticeGiven, ConditionCausedByTenantOrHousehold),
    !.
statute_41_121c_rent_excused_if_substitute_housing(_, _, _, _) :- fail.

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   41 OK Stat  41-121(D) (2021)
   Noncompliance rendering unit uninhabitable or posing imminent threat to health/safety,
   not remedied as promptly as conditions require -> tenant may immediately terminate
   upon written notice specifying noncompliance.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

% statute_41_121d_immediate_termination_available(+UninhabitableOrImminentThreat, +WrittenNoticeGiven, +ConditionCausedByTenantOrHousehold)
statute_41_121d_immediate_termination_available(true, WrittenNoticeGiven, ConditionCausedByTenantOrHousehold) :-
    statute_41_121_remedy_prereqs_met(WrittenNoticeGiven, ConditionCausedByTenantOrHousehold),
    !.
statute_41_121d_immediate_termination_available(_, _, _) :- fail.

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   41 OK Stat  41-123 (2021)
   If landlord wrongfully removes/excludes tenant -> tenant may recover possession
   or terminate after notice, and recover up to twice monthly rent or twice actual damages.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

% statute_41_123_remedy_available(+WrongfulRemovalOrExclusion)
statute_41_123_remedy_available(true) :- !.
statute_41_123_remedy_available(_) :- fail.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario encoding (facts) + scenario_statement/0
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* The question provides only a generic scenario:
   - There is an eviction action.
   - Tenant seeks to use landlord noncompliance with a statutory duty as a rebuttal/defense.
   It does NOT specify:
   - the eviction ground (e.g., nonpayment),
   - that the tenant gave written notice,
   - that tenant used repair-and-deduct,
   - that substitute housing was procured, etc.
*/

% proceeding_type(eviction_action).
proceeding_type(eviction_action).

% eviction_ground/1 is unknown from the prompt; encode explicitly as unknown.
% Common grounds could be nonpayment, holdover, breach, etc., but not provided.
eviction_ground(unknown).

% tenant_attempts_defense(DefenseTheory).
tenant_attempts_defense(landlord_noncompliance_with_statutory_duty).

% Landlord noncompliance is alleged in general; no further statutory prerequisites given.
alleged_landlord_noncompliance(true).

% Notice facts: not stated; encode as unknown (not proven true).
written_notice_given(false).

% Causation exception (tenant caused condition): not stated; encode as unknown/false for modeling.
% Here we encode "not established that tenant caused it" as false (i.e., condition not caused by tenant).
condition_caused_by_tenant_or_household(false).

% Additional remedy-specific facts (not stated):
repair_cost(unknown).
essential_service_failure(unknown).
substitute_housing_procured_with_notice(unknown).
uninhabitable_or_imminent_threat(unknown).
wrongful_removal_or_exclusion(unknown).

% scenario_statement/0 succeeds when the encoded scenario matches the prompt.
scenario_statement :-
    qa_state(oklahoma),
    focus_year(2021),
    proceeding_type(eviction_action),
    tenant_attempts_defense(landlord_noncompliance_with_statutory_duty),
    alleged_landlord_noncompliance(true),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Reasoning: when does "landlord noncompliance" function as a defense in eviction?
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* We treat "defense in eviction" narrowly as:
   - A statutory rule that directly authorizes using landlord noncompliance as a defense; OR
   - A statutory tenant right that negates an eviction element (most plausibly: nonpayment),
     e.g., rent lawfully deducted/excused under 41-121(B) or 41-121(C)(4).

   Under the provided statutes, there is no express "defense to eviction" clause.
   Thus, the only path is an implied rebuttal to a nonpayment eviction via lawful deduction/excuse.
*/

% eviction_defense_based_on_statutory_noncompliance_available/0
eviction_defense_based_on_statutory_noncompliance_available :-
    scenario_statement,
    eviction_ground(nonpayment),
    tenant_nonpayment_is_legally_excused_or_offset,
    !.
eviction_defense_based_on_statutory_noncompliance_available :-
    fail.

% tenant_nonpayment_is_legally_excused_or_offset/0
tenant_nonpayment_is_legally_excused_or_offset :-
    lawful_repair_and_deduct_applies,
    !.
tenant_nonpayment_is_legally_excused_or_offset :-
    lawful_rent_excuse_substitute_housing_applies,
    !.
tenant_nonpayment_is_legally_excused_or_offset :-
    fail.

% lawful_repair_and_deduct_applies/0 (models 41-121(B) prerequisites; needs cost and notice)
lawful_repair_and_deduct_applies :-
    repair_cost(Cost),
    number(Cost),
    written_notice_given(WrittenNotice),
    condition_caused_by_tenant_or_household(CausedByTenant),
    statute_41_121b_repair_and_deduct_available(true, true, Cost, WrittenNotice, CausedByTenant),
    !.
lawful_repair_and_deduct_applies :-
    fail.

% lawful_rent_excuse_substitute_housing_applies/0 (models 41-121(C)(4) prerequisites)
lawful_rent_excuse_substitute_housing_applies :-
    essential_service_failure(ESF),
    ESF == true,
    substitute_housing_procured_with_notice(SH),
    SH == true,
    written_notice_given(WrittenNotice),
    condition_caused_by_tenant_or_household(CausedByTenant),
    statute_41_121c_rent_excused_if_substitute_housing(true, true, WrittenNotice, CausedByTenant),
    !.
lawful_rent_excuse_substitute_housing_applies :-
    fail.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% housing_answer/1 (must be deterministic; yes/no)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    eviction_defense_based_on_statutory_noncompliance_available,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: In an eviction action, can a tenant use landlord noncompliance with a statutory duty as a rebuttal/defense?
